text:
Type: nesting side tables, set of two
Use: setting down drinks, lamps and books; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: birch veneer tops, bent solid birch legs, clear lacquer
Colors: pale natural birch, light blond wood
Shape: two rounded oval tops, the smaller one sliding under the larger, three curved bent-wood legs each, light and compact
Feel: airy, calm, natural, versatile
Goes with: white walls, linen, light wood floors; Scandinavian or Japandi living rooms

product.name: SVALSTA
product.description: Can be used individually or be pushed together to save space.
